title: The 4 Best Juicers for Beginners
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for juicers for beginners, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers for beginners using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville Juice Fountain Cold
products.blurb: Key specs: 850W motor, Cold Spin Technology, 70oz juice jug.
strengths: One of the simplest juicers to operate, drop produce in, press a button
Easy rinse-clean design lowers the biggest barrier to sticking with the habit
Large capacity jug means less stopping to empty during a session
limitations: Lower yield on leafy greens than a masticating juicer
Larger footprint than the more compact budget options
features: Rinses clean with water in most cases

products.name: NutriBullet Juicer Pro NBJ50200
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W high-torque motor, 27oz sealing juice pitcher, 3-inch feed chute with dual-size pusher.
strengths: Lowest price of the beginner-friendly options here
Wide 3-inch feed chute reduces pre-cutting for most fruits and vegetables
Dishwasher-safe parts remove most of the cleanup friction
limitations: Some owners report excess foam with high-water-content produce
Weaker yield on leafy greens than premium centrifugal or masticating options
Motor is louder relative to its juicing output than pricier models

products.name: Omega J8006HDS Masticating Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: 80 RPM dual-stage auger, 200W motor, 37oz juice container.
strengths: Simple three-position switch (on/off/reverse) is not much harder to learn than a centrifugal juicer
Better yield and less foam than any centrifugal beginner option
15-year warranty removes the risk of buying a machine that won't last
limitations: Slower pace takes some adjustment for someone used to a fast centrifugal machine
More assembly and disassembly steps for cleaning
Higher upfront price than the other beginner picks here

products.name: Hamilton Beach Big Mouth 2-Speed Juicer (67750)
strengths: Two speeds for soft and hard produce

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
